propositions: Hand-maintained package help and parser factories are misaligned; generated help artifacts must be authoritative and deterministic from the true factory grammar to correct accumulated drift.

A new gen_cli_help.py script with write and --check modes must enumerate routes, resolve factories, render canonicalized help with fixed prog/width/formatter/ordering/UTF-8 policy, and fail --check on stale/missing/non-deterministic/blank-summary artifacts.
The lexical pre-scan in _help_route.py must handle global config-prefix shape and top-level --help/help routes before operation/config/store/mount/parser/handler resolution or optional imports.
Factory enrichment in _parsers/core/ and _parsers/advanced/ must move curated prose from hand-authored help text into per-argument help= and description/epilog so the generator renders it.

Overview grouping, alias handling, hidden-route omission, and all committed help artifacts must be regenerated from the factory census; the capitalized Usage: prefix is the only byte-for-byte invariant preserved.
